Primary request: return the SAME TWELVE poses in the SAME 4x3 layout, but make EVERY whole stag face screen RIGHT instead of LEFT. Preserve each original action, body scale, four connected root legs, paired branch antlers, pale birch bark, dark green root muscles, red vine bindings, small empty saddle, amber oval chest gem, long trailing root tail and tan ribbons. No rider. Do not merely rotate heads; the whole anatomical body must face right. Keep each pose within its own original cell, no reordering or overlapping neighbors.
Change bottom row column2 to the corrected death buckle from Image2: both front knees bend deeply to ground and chest/head drop, rear hips remain raised, all four feet visible. Bottom row column3 is side fall; bottom row column4 is fully prone settled corpse. In all three bottom-row death cells columns2-4, eye and chest gem are completely unlit dark brown amber; final corpse has a closed dark eyelid, no bright eye dot or emitted light. Keep equipment and antlers throughout.
Other pose actions unchanged: idle, alert breath, extended gallop, gathered gallop, diagonal contact, crouched anticipation, low antler ram, defensive brace, hit recoil.
Background: flat pure MAGENTA RGB255,0,255 in every empty space and aperture, no checkerboard, gradient, ground, shadow or reflected magenta. Preserve original warm muted painterly texture and constant anatomical scale. Full entire 4x3 sheet with generous margins around antlers, toes, tail and corpse; no text, grid lines, extra limbs, detached roots, spell effects or glow clouds. Original game art, no copyrighted characters.
